name: Crisp
subcategory: help desks, live chat and support knowledge
tagline: Combine website chat and a shared inbox for one small support team

pricing.notes: Typical Mini workspace price; vendor may bill in EUR.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.limits: 2 agent seats, 100 customer profiles, unlimited conversations and 0 included AI credits

tiers.name: Mini
tiers.limits: 4 seats, 5,000 customer profiles, unlimited conversations and $5 AI credits/month (about 90 automated conversations)
tiers.notes: Yearly payment can be enabled in-app, but the public page does not state the yearly total or discount.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.limits: 10 seats, 50,000 customer profiles, 2 sub-inboxes and $25 AI credits/month (about 450 automated conversations)
tiers.notes: Yearly payment can be enabled in-app, but the public page does not state the yearly total or discount.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.limits: 20+ included seats, 200,000 customer profiles, 5 sub-inboxes and $75 AI credits/month (about 1,350 automated conversations)
tiers.notes: Additional seats cost $10/month; yearly payment can be enabled in-app but the public page does not state its rate.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: Custom onboarding, SLA, rate limits, features and training

pricing.freeTierCaps: 2 agent seats; 100 customer profiles; unlimited conversations; no included AI credits
pricing.billingTerms: monthly + yearly payment available; no public yearly price or stated annual discount; 14-day all-feature trial
pricing.hiddenCosts: AI overage is token-based pay-as-you-go after included credits; estimated $0.05-$0.10 per AI-handled conversation. Plus seats above the included 20+ cost $10/month; extra CRM contacts, agent capacity and other limits can cost extra; VAT may apply.

verdictSummary: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Crisp, combine website chat and a shared inbox for one small support team. The hard boundary is multi-channel inbox, chat delivery, knowledge base, campaigns, and workspace pricing, plus channel integrations and support operations.
coreLoopDIY: Receive website chat and customer messages into a shared inbox for one small support team, reply from one place, and retain a searchable conversation history.
whatYouLose: multi-channel inbox, chat delivery, knowledge base, campaigns, and workspace pricing
ongoingBurden: message delivery, webhooks, threading, identity, permissions, attachments, notifications, spam, search, uptime, and retention
whyPeopleStillPay: People still pay for Crisp because support software survives because missing or misrouting one customer message is expensive and every channel behaves differently. The recurring cost buys message delivery, webhooks, threading, identity, permissions, attachments, notifications, spam, search, uptime, and retention, not just the visible interface.

priorArt.name: Chatwoot
priorArt.desc: Mature open-source customer engagement and shared-inbox platform.

alternatives.name: Chatwoot
alternatives.desc: A proper support inbox with chat, email and a help center; free software, billable server chores.

facts.install: Docker Compose on a Linux VM, followed by environment, database, reverse-proxy and TLS configuration
facts.dataFormat: Application data in PostgreSQL, queues/cache in Redis, and attachments on local disk or S3-compatible/cloud object storage
facts.gapVsPaid: You replace Crisp's managed service with Docker, upgrades, backups and channel-deliverability work.
facts.setupBlocker: Provisioning a Linux server and correctly wiring DNS/TLS, SMTP, PostgreSQL/Redis and storage

alternatives.name: HubSpot Free CRM
alternatives.desc: A two-seat shared inbox and live chat bolted to a CRM; free until the limits become colleagues.

facts.install: Hosted signup, then connect a team inbox/email and add the website tracking or chat-widget code
facts.dataFormat: CRM contacts and conversation history in HubSpot's cloud; records export to spreadsheet files and conversations are available through its API
facts.gapVsPaid: The free inbox is limited to two users and feels CRM-first rather than like Crisp's compact omnichannel team inbox.
facts.setupBlocker: Connecting and verifying the shared email inbox and website domain

alternatives.name: Live Helper Chat
alternatives.desc: A battle-tested live-chat desk with routing, transcripts and canned replies; the interface has seen some things.

facts.install: Upload the release archive to a PHP web server and run the browser installer, or deploy its Docker image
facts.dataFormat: Chats and settings in MySQL/MariaDB, with uploads and media in writable server-side storage directories
facts.gapVsPaid: It covers chat well but has an older agent experience and a weaker shared-inbox and integration story than Crisp.
facts.setupBlocker: A PHP 8.2+/MySQL web host, a pre-created database and correct filesystem permissions

alternatives.name: tawk.to
alternatives.desc: Live chat, tickets and a knowledge base for zero dollars; the little badge is how the arithmetic survives.

facts.install: Hosted signup, then paste the generated JavaScript widget or install a CMS plugin
facts.dataFormat: Chats, tickets and contacts in tawk.to's cloud account; chat and ticket exports are JSON
facts.gapVsPaid: The free widget carries tawk.to branding and offers less flexible automation and inbox polish than Crisp.
facts.setupBlocker: Access to edit the website or install its CMS plugin

alternatives.name: LibreDesk
alternatives.desc: A modern email-and-live-chat desk in one compact stack, because apparently that was allowed.

facts.install: Run Docker Compose with an edited config file, or launch the release binary against PostgreSQL
facts.dataFormat: Records in PostgreSQL, queues/cache in Redis, and uploads on the local filesystem or S3-compatible object storage
facts.gapVsPaid: LibreDesk is newer, less proven and has far fewer integrations than Crisp.
facts.setupBlocker: Docker plus a correct config, encryption key, PostgreSQL/Redis and mail/channel credentials

alternatives.name: Odoo Helpdesk One App Free
alternatives.desc: A real hosted ticket desk for unlimited users, as long as Helpdesk is your one free Odoo app.

facts.install: Hosted Odoo Online signup with Helpdesk selected as the single free app
facts.dataFormat: An Odoo Online PostgreSQL database in Odoo's cloud, with record exports and downloadable ZIP database backups
facts.gapVsPaid: Its one-app-free constraint makes expansion awkward, and the support experience is less focused than Crisp's.

alternatives.name: HubSpot Free Help Desk
alternatives.desc: A hosted shared inbox, live chat, and ticket queue for two users; the knowledge base lives upstairs.

facts.install: Hosted signup, then connect a team inbox/email and add the website tracking or chat-widget code
facts.dataFormat: CRM records, tickets and conversation history in HubSpot's cloud; records export to spreadsheet files and conversations are available through its API
facts.gapVsPaid: Two free users and paywalled knowledge-base and automation depth create a much tighter ceiling than Crisp.
facts.setupBlocker: Connecting and verifying the shared email inbox and website domain

rejectedAlternatives.name: Chaskiq
rejectedAlternatives.desc: The homepage still smiles; the repo carries an open abandonment report and years of unresolved production-install breakage.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Papercups
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Everyone still recommends it; the main repo has not moved since February 2024.

notes: Editorial comparison targets the Mini plan and a small-team shared inbox DIY substitute. Recheck price before merge.
prompt:
Build a personal replacement for Crisp in an empty repository.
Use Next.js 15, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, WebSockets, and Docker Compose; do not offer alternative stacks.
The core loop is: receive website chat and customer messages into a shared inbox for one small support team, reply from one place, and retain a searchable conversation history.
Make the first run work locally with one documented command.
Store all user data locally by default and make export straightforward.
Put secrets in .env, ship .env.example, and never commit credentials.
Implement one workspace, agents, contacts, inboxes, conversations, messages, labels, and assignment.
Provide a website chat widget with reconnect, unread counts, file limits, and clear availability state.
Create a shared inbox with filters, collision warnings, notes, canned replies, and searchable history.
Add email notifications, browser notifications, and an immutable assignment and status log.
Implement spam controls, attachment scanning hooks, retention settings, export, and contact deletion.
Ship Docker Compose, backups, health checks, migrations, and a documented admin recovery flow.
Include clear empty, loading, success, and recoverable error states.
Add input validation, safe filenames, and graceful handling of unavailable APIs.
Write focused tests for the core transformation and one end-to-end happy path.
Create a README with setup, architecture, permissions, data location, and backup steps.
Do not add accounts, billing, telemetry, analytics, or a hosted control plane.
Deliberately leave out many social and messaging channels.
Deliberately leave out AI agents trained on proprietary support data.
Deliberately leave out enterprise workforce management, SSO, and compliance.
Finish by running the tests and listing the exact commands used.
